SELECT sri.role_names, bcp.* FROM bd_campus_personnel bcp # 查到对应的登录人员信息 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_type = 0 AND su.association_id = bcp.id # 如果如果有传roleId的话，那么就说明只查拥有该角色的，所以可以用join，其他时候用left join 是为了避免没有分配角色的用户不展示出来
JOIN
LEFT JOIN
( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( sr.role_name ) role_names, sur.user_id FROM sys_user_role sur JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.role_id WHERE campus_id = #{campusId} AND mec_id = #{mecId} AND user_type = 0 AND sr.status = 0
and sr.role_id = #{roleId}
GROUP BY sur.user_id # 通过登录人员关联权限表 ) sri ON sri.user_id = su.user_id WHERE bcp.mec_id = #{mecId} AND bcp.campus_id = #{campusId} AND bcp.is_delete = 0 # 只查询校区人员，不查询校区负责人 AND bcp.type = 1 # 对应sys_user中类型为校区人员的id AND su.type = 1
and bcp.phone like concat("%", #{phone},"%")
ORDER BY create_time desc
, bcp.id DESC
